name: Beechcraft Bonanza A36 / F33
summary: Conventional-tail Bonanzas: the shorter 33 series and the stretched six-seat A36/G36, still in production as a premium piston single.

wings: Low, tapered wing with marked dihedral
engines: Single flat-six with a long, smooth cowl
fuselage: A36: long cabin with four side windows and large double doors on the right rear
tail: Conventional swept fin with low horizontal tail (no V-tail)

tellTales: Long low-wing retractable single with double doors on the right rear
Conventional tail on a slim, rounded fuselage
Long smooth cowl with a three-blade prop

confusedWith.howToTell: The V35 has a V-tail; the A36/F33 has a conventional fin and horizontal tail.
The PA-32's rear double doors are on the left and it has a stabilator; the A36's rear doors are on the right.
The Malibu/M-series has a taller fin and a pressurized cabin with small windows and an airstair door on the left.
The A36 has a shorter fin and a deeper cabin with a big rear cargo door; the Viking has a much larger, taller fin and a slimmer cabin.
The A36 has a squared tail and rear cargo doors; the Commander has a bulkier cabin and a swept tail.
